nodes.label: v1 report list (Dashboard, Outlets, Staff, Pulangan)
nodes.norm_label: v1 report list (dashboard, outlets, staff, pulangan)
nodes.rationale: Show pass rate beside coverage: a high pass rate on low coverage is the classic false comfort.

nodes.label: Generated pct column (never stored as input)
nodes.norm_label: generated pct column (never stored as input)
nodes.rationale: marks.pct = total_score/max_score generated so a score cannot disagree with its lines; fixes the workbook defect where a percentage cell outlived its numbers.

nodes.label: Totals vs percentages rounding note
nodes.rationale: Workbooks stored weekly percentages, schema stores totals; where a total cannot express the original percentage (83% of 85), generated pct lands within a point.

nodes.label: Pre-October coverage may be under-counted
nodes.rationale: report_due uses users.joined_on, which defaults to row creation date; people created after a month with no mark are not counted due, inflating coverage.

nodes.label: One mark per person per week (promotions)
nodes.norm_label: one mark per person per week (promotions)
nodes.rationale: KK0005, KM0010, PM0029 promoted staff to SV/AS; where both sheets existed the staff mark was kept; group by marks.form_key not current role.

nodes.label: Due definition (who is due a mark)
nodes.norm_label: due definition (who is due a mark)
nodes.rationale: Due when active, posted, on a role with a form, joined by month end (from week of joined_on) or marked in that month; due on form last marked on that month.

nodes.label: pct_sum re-aggregation (sum counts, never average percentages)
nodes.norm_label: pct_sum re-aggregation (sum counts, never average percentages)
nodes.rationale: Every view carries pct_sum so averages re-derived from summed rows equal the database's own.

nodes.label: report_* views data contract
nodes.rationale: Reports read report_* views rather than assembling aggregates in the browser so both apps quote the same numbers; no second copy of business rules.

nodes.label: Permissive RLS fails silently
nodes.rationale: Wrong policies still return rows, just the wrong ones; so tests assert what each role cannot read.

nodes.label: app_can_see_branch(text)
nodes.rationale: Single predicate every scoped policy calls; change the scoping rule in one place, not twenty policies.

nodes.label: payroll-auth Edge Function
nodes.rationale: Supabase Auth only knows e-mail; function resolves payroll number to login address server-side so the browser never sees it.

nodes.label: marks-app web HTML shell (PWA)
nodes.rationale: Installable from the phone browser via Add to Home Screen; full-screen icon is how the pilot ships without an app store.

nodes.label: Payroll number identity (users.id)
nodes.rationale: Identity is the payroll number; it can change on transfer via payroll_id_changes, so key lists on users.id and don't cache number-to-person maps.

nodes.label: Supabase back end (Postgres RLS, Auth, Edge Functions)
nodes.norm_label: supabase back end (postgres rls, auth, edge functions)

nodes.label: Reporting web app (reports-web, GM/HR)
nodes.rationale: Read-only, desktop-first second front end on the same Supabase back end, so both apps quote the same numbers; free tiers, one-person maintenance, Vercel.

nodes.label: RLS branch scoping
nodes.rationale: Scoping enforced by RLS not the client: a supervisor querying another outlet gets zero rows. Admin cross-branch, everyone else own branch_id, reference tables readable by any signed-in user.

nodes.label: SECURITY DEFINER RLS helpers (auth bridge)
nodes.rationale: Branch scoping needs caller's branch_id from users, the table the policy guards; reading it directly re-enters its own policy. SECURITY DEFINER runs that lookup outside RLS; search_path pinned to block escalation.

nodes.label: Malay-first ms/en dictionary
nodes.rationale: Bahasa Melayu primary, English toggle persisted in localStorage; keep labels staff already know.

nodes.label: Manager blind to stor side by RLS
nodes.norm_label: manager blind to stor side by rls

nodes.label: No service-role key; anon key + session JWT
nodes.norm_label: no service-role key; anon key + session jwt

nodes.label: Reports app refuses roles other than GM/HR (admin optional)
nodes.norm_label: reports app refuses roles other than gm/hr (admin optional)

nodes.label: Read Expo v57 versioned docs before coding
nodes.norm_label: read expo v57 versioned docs before coding
nodes.rationale: Expo has changed; agent knowledge may be stale, so consult https://docs.expo.dev/versions/v57.0.0/ first.

nodes.label: Blueprint Construction Guides (concentric circles, dashed triangle, baseline)
nodes.norm_label: blueprint construction guides (concentric circles, dashed triangle, baseline)

nodes.label: Stock Expo Template Icon Artwork (not custom app branding)
nodes.norm_label: stock expo template icon artwork (not custom app branding)
nodes.rationale: The guide-line backdrop matches the default create-expo-app template, suggesting Checklist Mingguan has not yet received its own icon design.

nodes.label: Glossy Blue Chevron / Caret Mark
nodes.rationale: Rounded upward-pointing chevron with a dark-to-light blue gradient and soft drop shadow; this is the default Expo template mark rather than a checklist-specific symbol.

nodes.label: Small Blue Chevron on Pale Blue Tile
nodes.norm_label: small blue chevron on pale blue tile

nodes.label: Blue Chevron over Blueprint Construction Grid
nodes.norm_label: blue chevron over blueprint construction grid

nodes.label: Placeholder Branding (default Expo template icon)
nodes.rationale: Nothing in the artwork refers to checklists, weeks or the business; it matches Expo's default template, so a custom icon may still be pending.

nodes.label: Android Adaptive Icon Background
nodes.rationale: Back layer of the Android adaptive launcher icon: pale blue (#E6F4FE-like) field with thin blue construction guides, so the foreground chevron sits on a blueprint-style backdrop when Android masks the icon.

nodes.label: Android Adaptive Icon Foreground
nodes.rationale: Front layer of the Android adaptive launcher icon: the blue gradient chevron alone on transparency, centred inside the safe zone so Android can mask and parallax it over the background layer.

nodes.label: Android Monochrome (Themed) Icon
nodes.rationale: Single-colour grey silhouette of the chevron for Android 13+ themed icons, where the launcher tints the shape to the user's wallpaper palette.

nodes.label: Web Favicon
nodes.rationale: Tiny (48px) browser-tab icon for the web build: a small blue chevron on a pale blue rounded square, with the construction guides dropped because they would be unreadable at this size.

nodes.label: App Icon (1024px master)
nodes.rationale: Full-bleed 1024px square app icon (used for iOS and as the general Expo icon): glossy blue chevron composited over the pale blue blueprint guides. It is the stock create-expo-app artwork, so Checklist Mingguan still ships placeholder branding.

nodes.label: Splash Screen Icon
nodes.rationale: Image shown on the launch splash while the JS bundle loads: light grey square grid with three concentric circles on white. It carries no logo or app name, consistent with the default Expo template splash placeholder.

nodes.label: PWA Icon 192px
nodes.rationale: 192px web-app manifest icon (home-screen shortcut size) served from public/; same blue chevron over blueprint guides as the main app icon, downscaled.

nodes.label: PWA Icon 512px
nodes.rationale: 512px web-app manifest icon (install / splash size for the PWA) served from public/; the same chevron-on-blueprint artwork as assets/icon.png at half resolution.

nodes.label: Reconciliation with workbook JUMLAH MARKAH
nodes.rationale: Staff ~98% identical, SV 913 of 960; differences come from scores on non-perkara rows and workbook SUM range errors; DB is the correct figure.

nodes.label: Scorer list / scorer_ids.xlsx mapping
nodes.rationale: Converter writes every scorer name per workbook; payroll_id filled in and passed back; a name is fallback matched among scorers at the person's outlet.

nodes.label: 2026 marks history import (Jan-Sep)
nodes.rationale: Paper-era workbooks for Jan-Sep 2026 imported 2 Oct 2026 so the reports app has nine months of history; 6,411 staff and 931 SV/AS week-marks.

nodes.label: keep mode (never overwrite app-entered week)
nodes.rationale: A week already marked in the phone app was kept and the workbook version skipped, so live monthly totals may differ by a handful.

nodes.label: Month/week from block labels, not TARIKH dates
nodes.norm_label: month/week from block labels, not tarikh dates
nodes.rationale: TARIKH dates typo-prone and one outlet fills a month behind; October left out for that reason.

nodes.label: Totals summed from perkara, not JUMLAH cell
nodes.norm_label: totals summed from perkara, not jumlah cell
nodes.rationale: Blank/N/A perkara left out of max, so max_score varies; always use pct.

nodes.label: Two cohorts never blended (kedai vs sv)
nodes.norm_label: two cohorts never blended (kedai vs sv)

nodes.label: mark_verifications table
nodes.rationale: The manager pass; absence is the signal.

nodes.label: NULL scored_by (no scorer recorded)
nodes.rationale: 288 staff and 30 SV weeks; show a dash, not a guess; resolve scorers through users without filtering on active.

nodes.label: Pass threshold (scoring_rules.pass_threshold)
nodes.rationale: Join, don't hardcode 80.

nodes.label: Marks snapshot their context (branch_id, form_key)
nodes.rationale: People transfer branches and change roles; a mark must stay attached to the branch and form it was scored under or historical reports silently rewrite themselves.

nodes.label: useMarks.draft stays client state
nodes.rationale: An in-progress checklist is client state until submitted; add mark_drafts keyed by (user_id, scored_by) only if drafts must survive reinstall.

nodes.label: Imported marks filed under current outlet
nodes.norm_label: imported marks filed under current outlet
nodes.rationale: marks.branch_id set to person's outlet at import; transfers during 2026 file earlier weeks under current outlet.

nodes.label: Verification not recorded before the app
nodes.norm_label: verification not recorded before the app
nodes.rationale: No mark_verifications imported; business chose to keep imported weeks open, so verified % ~0 for Jan-Sep must be labelled, not presented as a finding.

nodes.label: A confirmed mark is fixed (app_mark_verified())
nodes.rationale: Once mark_verifications holds a row, total/max/mark_lines cannot change via RLS; only adjusted_to may.

nodes.label: return_stage_gaps view
nodes.rationale: Orders by chain position, not date, so two stages on the same day still read forwards.

nodes.label: Pulangan KPI rules (submission, ageing 60 days, grace)
nodes.norm_label: pulangan kpi rules (submission, ageing 60 days, grace)

nodes.label: Workbook week (week_no 1-4, not ISO)
nodes.rationale: Every month has exactly four marking weeks matching the paper form; only returns KPI uses ISO weeks because its deadline is the Friday of arrival week.

nodes.label: Ageing is derived, never stored
nodes.rationale: return_events records what happened and when; turnaround and stage gaps are computed, e.g. now() - opened_on.

nodes.label: security_invoker views (Postgres 15+)
nodes.rationale: Without security_invoker a view runs as its owner and quietly bypasses every RLS policy; this is why Postgres 15+ is required.

nodes.label: Stage ownership is not a security boundary
nodes.norm_label: stage ownership is not a security boundary
nodes.rationale: Which of store or clerk records which return step stays in the app; DB enforces branch and role.

nodes.label: mark_coverage view
nodes.rationale: Exposes person x week cells with no mark: the workbook #DIV/0! problem stated as a query.

nodes.label: Missing rows are meaningful
nodes.rationale: Gaps are data; mark_coverage returns 32 of 44 gaps for Machang and 12 of 16 for Kota Bharu on the seed.

nodes.label: graphify knowledge graph (project rules)
nodes.rationale: Use graphify query/path/explain before raw grep because they return a scoped subgraph much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or grep output.

nodes.label: Run graphify update after code changes
nodes.norm_label: run graphify update after code changes
nodes.rationale: Keeps graph current; AST-only so no API cost.

nodes.label: branches table
nodes.rationale: Outlets; short code (e.g. MCG) is permanent primary key.

nodes.label: scoring_rules table
nodes.rationale: Per-branch pass threshold, scale, whether manager verification required.

nodes.label: users table
nodes.rationale: Every account; role and branch_id mutable, id (payroll no.) is not.

nodes.label: Seed provenance (REAL vs NEW rows)
nodes.rationale: Real rows from workbooks (Machang, 22-perkara kedai form, September percentages); invented rows (Kota Bharu, stor form, returns) to be replaced before go-live.
